snippet.title: Zodiac Mountain Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
⛰️ ZODIAC MOUNTAIN – Official Gameplay Teaser🐼🔥
A mystical journey through ancient myth, mastery, and the elements begins now.

Step into the paws of a young panda determined to earn a place among the legendary Chinese Zodiacs. In Zodiac Mountain, you'll harness the power of Yin & Yang, master the Five Elements, and challenge powerful mythical foes through strategic, turn-based deckbuilding combat.

🌟 Wishlist us now on Steam and follow our journey up Zodiac Mountain:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2996150/Zodiac_Mountain/

🕊️ Follow for updates, dev insights, and behind-the-scenes:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mysticroadgames/
Discord: https://discord.gg/H9cjEqRGvc

#ZodiacMountain #indiegame  #deckbuilder  #chinesemythology  #gameplaytrailer #gameteaser
